name: Akechi Mitsuhide
source:
Hobby: Eliminating Those Against Him

This educated man is good at almost anything, but unfortunately he has a poor gustation. He has made up his mind to devote his life to Nobunaga.

[Edited from [url=https://akasekaeng.ppgame.com/ikusa.html]English official site[/url]]
